headline: Committee approves CD1 version of Resolution 2695, defers Resolution 2686

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Motion to amend Resolution 2695 with the proposed CD1 version
meeting.summary: Members also took up Resolution 2611 on filling a County Council vacancy. The committee plans to take up the remaining charter amendments and deferred proposals when it reconvenes.
meeting.recap: The committee took up Resolution 2611, on filling a County Council vacancy.[[0:05:37]] Today, the charter allows a special election only if more than 15 months are left in the term.[[0:06:43]] The chair said moving the proposed six-month cutoff to a year seemed to have broad support.[[0:44:17]] Members deferred Resolution 2686, on those commission terms, without objection.[[1:30:43]] The budget director said that would be about $13 million in fiscal year 27.[[2:13:22]] The board's chair said its members want to keep it.[[3:10:06]] The chair asked staff for data on vacancies and quorum problems before and after the board began.[[3:33:37]] The committee will reconvene at 10 a.m. on Thursday.[[3:34:58]]
decided: Members approved replacing the resolution with the proposed CD1 version by voice vote.
meeting.next: Attorneys were asked to check whether barring an appointed member from running in the next election is legal. The attorneys were asked to say before Thursday if the commission term change must be a charter amendment. Staff will send the Board of Ethics a written question on why its proposal has its effective date. The committee plans to take up the remaining charter amendments and deferred proposals on Thursday.
